thoughts:
My decision on 2026-08-28: HOLD SPY (conviction: medium).

Nothing in my pre-committed rule set fired. SPY closed 771.90 on 8/28, up from the 8/24 swing low of 763.47 and 2.2% above my 755.00 abort level; the 8/13 high of 777.88 is intact within ~0.8%. The pullback since 8/13 was shallow (max -1.96% to 762.60 on 8/20) and price has recovered three of the last four sessions. Watcher is 'caution' with idiosyncratic single-stock items (Marvell, IREN) plus a Jackson Hole/Warsh event and geopolitical noise — none of that is SEVERE and none of it is a price fact. GLD (+14.6%) and crypto (BTC +24.2%, ETH +31.2%) have better 30-day momentum, but chasing a 30-day move into a Fed-speech catalyst is exactly the beta-plus-story trade this project has already killed, and it costs a round-trip to express. I trail the benchmark by ~0.5% purely from earlier cash days; the fix is not churn. Hold SPY, no new trade, no cost incurred.

What would prove me wrong: Unchanged, pre-committed and observable: (1) a single SPY close below 755.00 (under the 8/03 757.67 breakout bar) on or before 2026-09-15 -> breakout failed, sell to CASH; (2) two consecutive closes below 728.00 (the 6/26 728.99 / 7/29 729.46 shelf) before 2026-09-15 -> CASH; (3) Watcher SEVERE -> immediate exit to CASH ('caution' or a stale/unknown read does not qualify). Absent one of these events, I hold and place no new trades.

strategy.name: The Analyst — LLM daily reasoner
strategy.rule: One decision per US trading day by claude-opus-5 over prices, headlines, and the Watcher; guardrails in code: long only, 1 position, 1 trade/day, SEVERE=cash, $750 floor; its own API bill is charged to the account
strategy.backtest_cagr: NO BACKTEST POSSIBLE — sentiment/reasoning has no historical replay; the live run IS the test
strategy.backtest_maxdd: External evidence: LLM agents show no credible net-of-cost alpha (LiveTradeBench). Expectation: ~zero. API cost so far $1.33
strategy.note: Glass-box experiment: every decision logs verbatim reasoning plus a falsifier the attribution log scores later. Judged by kill_criteria.md like every other bot.
